theme.description: An all-in-one workspace for freelance creative video editors. The UI must feel like a high-end command center: striking contrasts, crisp typography, and minimal decoration. Avoid the generic 'SaaS purple/teal'. Rely on the brand's signature blue for emphasis against a stark dark canvas.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Keep consistent sizing (e.g., 20px for nav, 24px for actions).

logo.description: Brand Logo - Blue handwritten W mark. Use in sidebar header and invoice templates.

workspace_hero.description: Dark modern workspace desk. Use as a subtle background for the login/welcome state if needed, or in the empty states (opacity reduced).

motion.hover_effects: Subtle border color shifts (e.g., white/10 to white/30), background tints (white/5). No heavy scaling or bouncing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI (using .js files, NOT .tsx).
Do NOT use HTML input[type='date'] or native select. Use Shadcn Calendar and Select components.
Do NOT use the generic Shadcn 'rounded-md' card look. Override border-radius to 0 (rounded-none) to fit the editorial Swiss brutalist vibe.
Implement Recharts for Analytics/Revenue charts. Style charts using the brand blue (#1D4ED8) and stark white.
For the Invoice Generator, use an editable layout on the left, and a live PDF preview (or HTML preview that looks exactly like a printable A4 page) on the right.
Implement WhatsApp integration via a simple 'window.open(`https://wa.me/?text=...`)' button.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-invoice-btn').
Set up a fluid Kanban board with HTML5 Drag and Drop or a lightweight library (like dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd).
Ensure AI-style insights are surfaced in dedicated 'AI Insight' cards with a subtle glowing border (border-[#1D4ED8]/50) to distinguish them.
Currency must be hardcoded or formatted as INR (₹).
No authentication required. The app should load directly into the Dashboard.
